constraints: Single model at inference; ensembles forbidden; weight averaging (soups/SWA/EMA) allowed. Score averaging of checkpoints is an inference ensemble (roadmap §2)

MUSAN speech and external speech forbidden; WebRTC AEC/NS/AGC/VAD simulation and software codecs explicitly allowed; RNNoise office/coffee 'verify'; neural-codec round trip and enhancement pre-processor 'ask'; babble from own training speech 'likely allowed'; no progress/eval audio use (roadmap §2)

Eval-only reserve: never train on G.722/G.726/GSM/speex/G.711; anlmdn, acompressor, afftdn, dynaudnorm, vad_gate, packet_loss, bandlimit, resample8k, compand, agate, crystalizer, speechnorm; 11 reserved ESC-50 classes; data/augmentation_eval and data/augmentation/musan/music; dev audio and half B. New aug code must call assert_training_ops itself (b3wave/heldout_reserve.py, docs/dev_splits.md §7-8)
Training DSP must use implementations disjoint from sim_ops (WebRTC APM, webrtcvad, libopus PLC, RNNoise arnndn, DeepFilterNet, speexdsp) (next_steps_plan §2.4)
Known leak: B2f-lineage MUSAN pool includes MUSAN music (musan:1590 = 930 noise + 660 music), so sim_unseen_v1 is not a clean check
--loudness_norm --loudness_norm_lufs -23 runs before augmentation on train/dev/eval; every eval must pass it

Cycle limits: extra VRAM <= 4.0 GiB, peak <= 22.0 GiB, epoch time <= 1.3x base (base 30.7-31.2 min/epoch => ~40.6 min, ~5.4 h per 8 epochs, computed), <= 400 LOC per lever, <= 10 h per run; a two-view consistency lever (57.7-59.8 min/epoch) breaks the 1.3x cap against B2f
One RTX 4090 24 GB; augmentation runs in 64 CPU loader workers (ffmpeg 4.2, two subprocesses per codec call; heavy chains can make training data-bound)
Container restarts wipe system ffmpeg and the codec stage then silently no-ops; install deps in the rtc-sdd conda env
Protocol: one seed (1234), <= 10 epochs, keep_topk_by_wf1 7, keep_epochs 8, both readouts, null band +-0.5; noise band ~0.2-0.5 final, up to ~1.4 per set
Data: 75,785 train clips (61,432 spoof / 14,353 bona; ~1.5k English offline bona); train has no noisy audio and 2 of 7 platforms
Deadline: final eval data 2026-11-09, submission due 2026-11-16 (~30 days from 2026-10-17)
